why:
Item 2 is handled. Check 2 runs `node bin/greet.js Ada` at the PR head and "the same commands at the PR's base commit" and then compares the outputs, so it does not rely only on a hand-written string.

Item 1 is not handled. Check 4 reads the live page: "fetch the page (`curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/`) and search it for `--shout`". If the PR isn't merged, it says to report "FAIL". It never says that at the PR head the check should confirm that docs/index.md lists --shout and that pages.yml publishes docs/ from main. pages.yml comes up only in an advisory note ("If the PR changes that, line 4 is at risk"), which isn't a pass/fail check. So the check for line 4 still points at the live page instead of checking at the head what will publish it.
